dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Sandy came to ACC as a stray. Because of this, we do not know how she would do in a home environment. Sandy has been noted to be on-leash reactive towards people and dogs. Sandy is noted to pull hard towards people with a tense body, and she is not receptive to treats or squeakers. Sandy's finders report that she will lunge, bark/growl, and snap at dogs. Sandy was reported by her finder to be friendly and playful. Sandy is also noted to be a resource guarder, and she has a tense body and hovers over food and toys, growls/barks, and snaps.
dog.name: Sandy
